title: Exact preparation geometry, toolpaths and held assessment in both working views
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open process
manualSteps.instruction: Open the proof workspace, click Workflows, choose the saved wheel process and click Use saved process.

manualSteps.label: Inspect the failed run
manualSteps.instruction: Open the recorded first-run link and inspect its preparation results and human-review hold.

manualSteps.label: Reuse the interface
manualSteps.instruction: Click Create or choose interface, select Focus-wheel configured preparation and click Open saved interface.

manualSteps.label: Inspect geometry
manualSteps.instruction: Reload the saved working interface, then click Open representation on repaired_mesh.stl.

manualSteps.label: Inspect producer
manualSteps.instruction: Return to the saved interface and click Open producing step on repaired_mesh.stl.

steps.label: Workspace offers Workflows
steps.purpose: Verify the normal workspace route with real API owners.
steps.action: Open Repeated focus-wheel preparation proof workspace.
steps.expected: The workspace loads and offers Workflows.
steps.actual: Normal workspace and Workflows control visible.

steps.label: Workflows opens the editor
steps.summary: The established workflow editor is available inside the workspace.
steps.purpose: Verify actual workspace entry without mocking.

steps.label: Workflow file controls
steps.summary: The workspace offers named saved workflows.
steps.purpose: Use the existing saved file chooser.

steps.label: Choose the focus-wheel workflow
steps.summary: The exact accepted focus-wheel workflow appears in the saved files.
steps.purpose: Choose the engineering process by its saved file.
steps.expected: The accepted focus-wheel workflow is listed.

steps.label: Focus-wheel workflow diagram
steps.summary: The original focus-wheel assignment opens with its connected review, geometry and slicing stages.
steps.purpose: Keep authoring and working views on the accepted source.
steps.action: Choose the accepted focus-wheel workflow file.
steps.expected: Accepted focus-wheel diagram and working view action available.
steps.actual: Exact saved focus-wheel source is open.

steps.label: Shared working view
steps.summary: The process working interface opens in another Wright workspace tab.
steps.purpose: Verify shared inputs and readiness without creating another executor.
steps.expected: Common working view in a workspace tab.

steps.label: Attach the actual focus-wheel run
steps.summary: The working view reads the same isolated backend run.
steps.purpose: Use actual process state for interface composition.
steps.action: Reopen the recorded focus-wheel run link.
steps.expected: The common working view attaches without starting another run.

steps.label: Common view retains the actual failure and preparation results
steps.summary: The full preparation chain remains available with its original mandatory engineering-review hold.
steps.purpose: Check exact common-view identities and the real human-review-hold diagnostic.
steps.action: Inspect the common working view of the recorded failed run.
steps.expected: Twenty exact first-run results and the original mandatory human-review hold.
steps.actual: Common results match the authoritative failed-run contract.

steps.label: Common view reads the retained source geometry
steps.summary: The actual repaired STL is inspectable despite the later repair-human-review hold.
steps.purpose: Verify the exact common result uses the shared bounded geometry reader.
steps.action: Click Open representation on the repaired_mesh.stl result.
steps.expected: A visible 3D canvas for the actual first-run source.
steps.actual: Actual repaired geometry is visible in the common view.

steps.label: Common view exposes actual nominal toolpaths
steps.summary: All recorded layers are available, with layer and support visibility controls.
steps.purpose: Inspect the exact provider-derived passive paths without executing machine commands.
steps.action: Open support-preview.json, select layer two, hide supports, then restore all layers and supports.
steps.expected: 90 recorded layers with working visibility controls.
steps.actual: Exact recorded nominal paths and controls render in the common view.

steps.label: Saved working interface agrees with the common view
steps.summary: The same built interface retains exact preparation-result identities and the real failure.
steps.purpose: Verify common/tailored evidence and failure parity without authoring again.
steps.action: Select Focus-wheel configured preparation and click Open saved interface.
steps.expected: Exact same twenty result identities and original review-hold diagnostic.
steps.actual: Saved working interface agrees with the common view.

steps.label: Actual source geometry remains inspectable
steps.summary: The exact constructed STL opens in the shared 3D viewer; physical fit, strength and print acceptance remain unverified.
steps.purpose: Inspect real retained geometry through the scoped result reader.
steps.action: Reload the saved view and click Open representation on repaired_mesh.stl.
steps.expected: The exact first-run source STL and a visible 3D canvas.
steps.actual: The shared reader renders the exact source geometry within the tailored view.

steps.label: The original exact held assessment opens
steps.summary: The digital checks and required human review remain distinct from release.
steps.purpose: Verify exact assessment navigation and requested result focus.
steps.expected: 17 passed checks, one mandatory review hold, exact repaired result focus.
steps.actual: The original full source assessment opens on the exact requested result.

steps.label: Saved interface exposes the same actual nominal toolpaths
steps.summary: The shared viewer retains the recorded layers and honest passive scope.
steps.purpose: Verify common/tailored actual toolpath identity and control parity.
steps.action: Reopen the saved interface, open support-preview.json and exercise layer and support visibility controls.
steps.expected: The same 90 recorded layers and controls.
steps.actual: Identical nominal toolpath evidence renders in the saved interface.

steps.label: Exact producer opens in the accepted editor
steps.summary: The partial result leads to its actual repair and orientation block.
steps.purpose: Retain the complementary working view and detailed engineering inspection.
steps.action: Return to the saved view and click Open producing step on repaired_mesh.stl.
steps.expected: Accepted process and exact repaired-mesh producer selected.
steps.actual: The original producing block opens in the preserved editor.
